no_testable_kernel: No testable kernel exists inside the charter. The pitch's central observation—a 210-micron periodic arteriolar-caliber modulation—is not an inspected property of the raw images but an asserted result derived from human vessel masks, and its artery-specific version additionally depends on manual artery/vein labels that the official STARE site provides for only 10 images. A database-source classifier trained on those masks is not a medical imaging model, while a vascular-disease classifier on STARE's 20 heterogeneous images cannot support a decisive model-use experiment or separate anatomy from camera, digitization, cohort, diagnosis mix, and annotator tracing style. An automated vessel segmenter could compute generic caliber variation from a new fundus image, but substituting that measurement would supply the missing premise rather than extract it from the pitch; there is no verified periodic signal, public frozen medical model, and adequately sized public outcome cohort joined here. The Mönckeberg interpretation is therefore unsupported mechanism decoration, and no one-Colab experiment on the named data could credibly yield the required sentence that a medical model is using a named anatomical or physiological X.
